request.definition: Something a person asks of you. A request deserves an answer; it does not deserve obedience.
request.example: The request was reasonable, and the answer was still no.

software_architecture.definition: The high-level structure of a system: how its parts are divided and connected, decided before the details are written.

spec_blind_spot.definition: A part of a situation that a person cannot see well, because of what the person already knows.
spec_blind_spot.example: Her blind spot is the customer: the figure was right and nobody asked who was waiting for the machine.

spec_field.definition: An area of work that a person knows well enough to work in.
spec_field.example: His field is tax, so read the customs part with somebody else.
